title: Consolidate per-process IPC plane-bus and capability rendezvous files into single atomic manifests with batched tool bootstrap
goal: Eliminate the 400+ per-topic and per-capability file writes under <cache>/bus/<pid>/ during ToolRegistry::global() bootstrap (documented in docs/step1-acceptance.md) by publishing single per-copy atomic JSON manifests (routes.json / caps.json) and wrapping hooks().bootstrap_tools(&registry) in a batch publication guard, while preserving fallback discovery and dead-endpoint pruning for legacy topics/, prefixes/, and caps/ files.

results.tests: susi-core lib 508 passed, susi-tools lib 61 passed, susi-daemon runtime_admin 14 passed, architecture_tests 49 passed, lean_core_ceilings 2 passed, clippy 0 warnings

reuse.searched: Searched intellibitz/susi crates/susi-core/src/{plane_bus_ipc,registry_ipc,registry}.rs, crates/susi-config (atomic_replace_unsynced), crates/susi-tools/src/registry.rs, crates/susi-daemon/src/runtime_admin.rs, susi-commercial-apps, Apache-2.0 IPC patterns, and the locked Cargo dependency graph (susi-vendor-serde-json); existing atomic_replace_unsynced and serde_json primitives cover single-file rendezvous manifests with zero new dependencies.
